decisions.reason: The decision retains the existing placement of ESP32 decoupling capacitors; it does not change DCDC1 voltage regulation, rail sourcing, or compensation.
The resolved placement concerns ESP32 decoupling capacitors, while this candidate concerns separate AXP2101 and MT3608 converter capacitors whose placement remains unresolved.
Retaining ESP32 decoupling-capacitor placement does not alter the MT3608 boost rail's enable control, loads, or operating policy.
The ESP32 decoupling placement decision has no necessary effect on battery protection circuitry or cutoff behavior.
The source decision does not change which rails are monitored, the monitoring device, or measurement placement and coverage.
ESP32 supply-capacitor placement is independent of AXP2101 exposed-pad heat transfer and assembly requirements.
The source decision does not affect the panel power-button connector, its location, or its PWRON connection.
Keeping the ESP32 decoupling capacitors at their existing distance does not change the trace-width requirement for VBUS, +5V, or BAT-.
The ESP32 decoupling placement decision leaves the AXP2101 battery and system power-path behavior unchanged.
The source decision does not alter the charge-status display method, connector, LED circuit, or component population.
The source resolves only ESP32 decoupling placement and does not decide VRTC handling or change VBACKUP and PWROK access.
Retaining ESP32 decoupling-capacitor placement has no effect on the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, or pinout.
